analysis:
Integration of 16 units. The PR is CI, build-tooling and documentation only. It touches no provider runtime, WebSocket contract (TB-002), key custody (A-002/A-003), attestation (TB-009), App Attest (TB-011), add-on boundaries (TB-012/013) or the prefix cache (T-041). The T-041 cache is the provider's encrypted SSD tier, not the CI build cache.

Verified from replayed patches:
- action.yml adds a save-caches input, default 'false'. The Swift build, SwiftPM repos and Metal cache saves are gated on it. PR-side saves are removed, which narrows cache poisoning versus base (which let PRs save when nothing matched).
- component-changes.yml plumbs the mimo_audio output, and ci-component-paths.py adds COMPONENTS and MIMO_AUDIO. The docs state master pushes run every component. The audio gate can be skipped on PRs outside its inputs, which is a coverage tradeoff, not a security regression.
- docs-impact.yml adds a blob:none sparse checkout and keeps fetch-depth 0.
- install-release-cmake.sh now prefers $RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/cmake/3.31.12/universal when a .complete marker exists and the version string matches. Otherwise it downloads and sha256-verifies the archive. The cached path skips the checksum and trusts the runner image's tool cache. The docs say release, signing and publication jobs keep literal Blacksmith labels. The unseen ci.yml lines were not verified, so this is an unverified supply-chain contract. The fallback download keeps the sha256 check.
- The .git cache restore, with git fsck --connectivity-only and persist-credentials: false, was visible only in the ci.yml excerpts and the tests. fsck does not re-hash blobs, hooks or config, so integrity rests on the push-only save policy for master and dev. I saw no PR-writable path to it.

Remaining items for human review: the ci.yml head text beyond roughly line 536 was not seen. Confirm that the provider-test-gate and cluster gate conditions still require success for the selected lanes, that signing and release jobs never run on Darkbloom images or restore the .git cache from untrusted writers, and that SAVE_CACHES is enforced as the tests assert. Since the replay was incomplete (67 of 120 units), that uncertainty is retained. No qualifying findings.
